headline: Adaptation is changing to fit circumstances—the core skill for survival in a changing world
universal_truth: The environment changes; those who adapt survive; those who don't, don't
fun_facts: Chameleons change color not just for camouflage but also for temperature regulation and communication
Humans are the most adaptable species on Earth—we live in every climate from arctic to desert
The most adaptable species in history survived all five mass extinctions—cockroaches, sharks, crocodiles
discussion_questions: What have you had to adapt to recently?
How do you balance staying true to yourself and adapting to circumstances?

hook.script: The dinosaurs were perfect for their world. Then the world changed, and perfection became obsolete. The survivors weren't the strongest or smartest—they were the most adaptable. Adaptation isn't optional; it's the price of continuation.

cliff.script: Adaptation sounds like giving up—changing yourself to fit external demands. But refusing to adapt can mean extinction. What's the balance?
cliff.prompt: When should you adapt versus stand firm?

options.text: Adapt when circumstances genuinely change and old approaches no longer work; stand firm on core values but be flexible on methods
options.response: Yes. Wise adaptation changes methods while preserving purpose. Stubbornness that refuses any change is as dangerous as adaptability that abandons all principles.

options.text: Always stay true to yourself no matter what
options.response: Core values should be stable, but methods and approaches need to evolve...

fact1.title: Environment Wins
fact1.script: Long-term, the environment always wins. You can resist for a while, but ultimately what doesn't fit, disappears. This isn't fatalism—it's recognizing reality. The question is how to adapt wisely.

fact2.title: Core vs Surface
fact2.script: Successful adaptation distinguishes core from surface. Change methods, keep purpose. Change tactics, keep strategy. Change expression, keep values. Knowing what to protect and what to change is the art of adaptation.

fact3.title: Proactive Adaptation
fact3.script: The best adaptation is proactive—changing before you're forced to. Those who adapt early have options. Those who wait until crisis have only survival mode. Watch for change and adapt ahead of necessity.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The environment changes; those who adapt survive. Be flexible in methods while firm in values. Adapt before you must.

outro.script: That's Day 215. Tomorrow, we'll explore knowledge you're born with—instinct. Until then, identify one adaptation you've been resisting.

growTrack.title: Adaptation Inventory - What Needs to Change?
growTrack.activity: What circumstances in your life have changed, but your approach hasn't? Work context, relationship dynamics, personal capabilities? Where are you using old solutions for new problems? Proactive adaptation beats forced crisis response.
